name: taisly_agent_setup_start
description: Start browser-based Taisly authentication for an AI agent. Returns a loginUrl that the user must open and approve before checkin.

agent.description: Short agent slug, for example claude-code, codex, cursor, openclaw, or hermes-agent.

name: taisly_agent_checkin
description: Finish setup after the user approves the loginUrl in the browser. Saves the local Taisly agent credential for later CLI and MCP calls.

agent.description: Short agent slug used with taisly_agent_setup_start.

name: taisly_auth_status
description: Check whether the Taisly API key is valid and count connected social accounts.

name: taisly_platforms_list
description: List connected TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, X, Facebook, and other social accounts available to this API key.

name: taisly_platform_schema
description: Get posting constraints and supported settings for a destination platform.

platform.description: Platform name, for example TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, X, or Facebook.

name: taisly_platform_connect_start
description: Start browser-based connection for a social account. Returns a connectUrl that the user must open and approve in the browser.

platform.description: Platform to connect. Supported: instagram, tiktok, youtube, x, facebook.

name: taisly_platform_connect_check
description: Check whether a social account connection started by taisly_platform_connect_start has appeared in Taisly.

platform.description: Platform to check. Supported: instagram, tiktok, youtube, x, facebook.

name: taisly_posts_validate
description: Validate a local video path, destination platform IDs, caption, and optional schedule before publishing.

video.description: Local video path available to the agent.

settings.description: Optional per-platform posting settings. All fields are optional; omitted values keep the existing posting behavior. These settings apply to every selected account on the corresponding platform.

status.description: TikTok visibility. Choose a value permitted by the creator's account. Branded content cannot use SELF_ONLY.

comment_disabled.description: true disables comments; false does not override the creator's account restrictions.

duet_disabled.description: true disables Duet; false does not override the creator's account restrictions.

stitch_disabled.description: true disables Stitch; false does not override the creator's account restrictions.

brand_content_toggle.description: true discloses a paid partnership promoting a third-party business. Cannot be combined with status SELF_ONLY.

brand_organic_toggle.description: true discloses promotion of the creator's own business. May be combined with brand_content_toggle.

is_aigc.description: Whether this video is AI-generated. Omit to keep the existing behavior.

title.description: Optional YouTube video title, up to 100 characters. Omit to use the post caption.

scheduled.description: Optional ISO datetime or Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

name: taisly_posts_create
description: Start publishing or schedule a video post after explicit user confirmation. success: true means Taisly accepted the request, not that every platform published it. For an immediate post, use the returned historyId with taisly_posts_status and report success only when the per-platform status is SUCCESS.

video.description: Local video path available to the agent.

settings.description: Optional per-platform posting settings. All fields are optional; omitted values keep the existing posting behavior. These settings apply to every selected account on the corresponding platform.

status.description: TikTok visibility. Choose a value permitted by the creator's account. Branded content cannot use SELF_ONLY.

comment_disabled.description: true disables comments; false does not override the creator's account restrictions.

duet_disabled.description: true disables Duet; false does not override the creator's account restrictions.

stitch_disabled.description: true disables Stitch; false does not override the creator's account restrictions.

brand_content_toggle.description: true discloses a paid partnership promoting a third-party business. Cannot be combined with status SELF_ONLY.

brand_organic_toggle.description: true discloses promotion of the creator's own business. May be combined with brand_content_toggle.

is_aigc.description: Whether this video is AI-generated. Omit to keep the existing behavior.

title.description: Optional YouTube video title, up to 100 characters. Omit to use the post caption.

scheduled.description: Optional ISO datetime or Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

previewTime.description: Optional preview timestamp used by the Taisly posting API.

confirmed.description: Must be true only after explicit user confirmation.

name: taisly_posts_status
description: Fetch per-platform status for a Taisly post by historyId. Inspect data.result[].status: PENDING is still processing, SUCCESS is published, and FAILED is not published.

name: taisly_posts_list
description: List recent Taisly post history for status checks and audits.

name: taisly_reposts_list
description: List configured repost automations for connected social accounts.

name: taisly_reposts_create
description: Create a repost automation from one connected account to one or more destination accounts.
